exposed_pad.note: 5-pin SOT-23-5 ('K') package has no exposed thermal pad (unlike SOT-89 R/RA/RB and PSOP-8 packages, p.1 & p.4).

theta_ja_c_per_w.condition: SOT-23-5 junction-to-ambient thermal resistance (vs 165 °C/W SOT-89 and 51 °C/W PSOP-8 with 1.5x1.5 cm thermal pad)

tj_max_c.condition: Absolute maximum operating junction temperature +150°C (recommended operating TJ -40°C to +125°C)

pinout.name: VIN
pinout.description: High-voltage supply input (2.6 V to 24 V operating, 38 V abs max; maintain VIN >= 4.3 V for 3.3 V regulation per Note 9); decouple with 1.0 uF cap.

pinout.name: EN
pinout.description: Active-high enable input (>= 2.0 V ON, <= 0.4 V OFF, 1 uA typ current); 38 V abs max allows direct connection to 24 V VIN.

pinout.name: ADJ/NC
pinout.description: Not connected internally on fixed 3.3 V AP2204K-3.3TRG1; datasheet recommends tying to GND copper for thermal relief (ADJ on ADJ version).

pinout.name: VOUT
pinout.description: Regulated 3.3 V output; requires 2.2 uF low-ESR ceramic output capacitor (p.2 Typical Application Circuit).

vin_abs_max_v.condition: Absolute maximum VIN and Enable VCE supply input voltage (38 V max on both pins)

vin_min_v.condition: Recommended VIN minimum is larger of 2.6 V or VOUT + 1 V per Note 9 (>= 4.3 V recommended for 3.3 V output)

vout_v.condition: Fixed 3.3 V SOT-23-5 ordering option AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (top marking ID 'GAH')

vout_tolerance_pct.condition: ±2% (98% to 102% of specified VOUT) at VIN = VOUT + 1 V, IOUT = 100 uA, TJ = +25°C

iout_max_ma.condition: Guaranteed minimum continuous output current 150 mA (200 mA typ at VIN - VOUT = 1 V; abs max 250 mA, p.4; thermally limited at high VIN)

iq_typ_ua.condition: 20 uA typ at IOUT = 0 A (50 uA @ 100 uA; EPNP bipolar base drive pushes IGND to 0.5 mA @ 50 mA, 1.3 mA @ 100 mA, and 2.5 mA @ 150 mA)

ishdn_typ_ua.condition: 0.01 uA typ / 1.0 uA max at VIN = VOUT + 1 V, VEN in OFF mode

dropout_typ_mv.condition: 360 mV typ / 500 mV max at IOUT = 150 mA (320 mV @ 100 mA, 270 mV @ 50 mA; p.1 headlines 100 mV at 100 uA only)

psrr_db.condition: f = 100 Hz and f = 1 kHz, Ripple 0.5 Vp-p, VIN = VOUT + 1 V

min_cout_uf.condition: 2.2 uF low-ESR ceramic output capacitor (with 1.0 uF input capacitor)

design_gotchas.title: Severe 24 V High-Voltage Thermal Derating in SOT-23-5 (θJA = 250 °C/W Limits Load < 20 mA)
design_gotchas.detail: Despite a 24 V operating / 38 V abs max rating and 150 mA current spec, SOT-23-5 θJA = 250 °C/W (p.4) limits PD to 400 mW at TA = 25°C (160 mW at TA = 85°C) to stay within TJ <= 125°C. Dropping 24 V to 3.3 V (20.7 V differential) restricts continuous load to <= 19 mA at 25°C (<= 7.7 mA at 85°C), and dropping 12 V to 3.3 V allows <= 45 mA at 25°C. Full 150 mA in SOT-23-5 requires VIN <= ~5.9 V at 25°C.

design_gotchas.title: NRND Lifecycle Status — Diodes Inc Recommends Migrating New Designs to AP2205
design_gotchas.detail: Datasheet DS37168 Rev. 6-3 carries a red Page 1 banner and full-page watermarks stating 'NOT RECOMMENDED FOR NEW DESIGN — USE AP2205'. Use AP2204K-3.3TRG1 only for legacy BOM maintenance or cross-referencing; select active high-voltage alternatives (e.g., AP2205 or TPS70933DBVR, noting EN voltage differences) for new boards.

design_gotchas.title: EPNP Bipolar Pass Transistor Draws 2.5 mA Ground Current at 150 mA & Needs 2.0 V EN
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike CMOS LDOs with flat microamp IQ, AP2204's high-voltage EPNP bipolar pass element escalates IGND from 20 uA at no load to 0.5 mA (50 mA), 1.3 mA (100 mA), and 2.5 mA (150 mA) (p.5). Also VEN(HI) >= 2.0 V is incompatible with 1.8 V MCU GPIOs — though its 38 V EN rating safely permits direct tie to 12 V/24 V VIN (a key safety advantage over TPS70933DBVR's 7 V EN clamp).

design_gotchas.title: Front-Page 100 mV Dropout Applies Only at 100 uA & Pin 4 Thermal Grounding Caution
design_gotchas.detail: Page 1 headlines VDROP = 100 mV at 100 uA, while full-load 150 mA dropout is 360 mV typ / 500 mV max (p.5), and Note 9 (p.4) advises VIN >= VOUT + 1 V (4.3 V) for reliable regulation. Page 3 recommends tying Pin 4 (NC) to GND copper for thermal relief, which conflicts with Pin-4 BYP/NR SOT-23-5 LDOs if swapped later.

typical_use_cases: Legacy 12 V / 24 V industrial, automotive-accessory, or adapter keep-alive 3.3 V rails at light load (<= 15–40 mA)
High-voltage surge-tolerant (38 V abs max on VIN & EN) 3.3 V bias supplies where EN ties directly to VIN
Low-noise (30 uVRMS) 3.3 V sensor and analog rails from 5–12 V intermediate buses with 2.2 uF ceramic COUT
Cross-reference migration baseline for engineers replacing NRND AP2204K-3.3TRG1 with AP2205 or TPS70933DBVR
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (NRND — Use AP2205) is a high-voltage EPNP 150 mA fixed 3.3 V (±2% at 25°C) LDO in a 5-pin SOT-23-5 ('K') package (1=VIN, 2=GND, 3=EN active high, 4=NC, 5=VOUT). Rated for 2.6 V to 24 V operating and 38 V absolute maximum on both VIN and EN, it offers 20 uA no-load IQ (rising to 2.5 mA at 150 mA load), 0.01 uA shutdown, 360 mV typ / 500 mV max dropout at 150 mA, 60 dB PSRR (1 kHz), 30 uVRMS noise, and 2.2 uF ceramic stability. Engineers must strictly respect its 250 °C/W SOT-23-5 thermal limit (< 19 mA continuous at 24 V / 25°C), 2.0 V EN logic high threshold, and NRND lifecycle status.
